hostname.description: The hostname this XMPP-to-IRC gateway will advertise to XMPP clients.

port.description: The port on which the XMPP component listens for incoming connections (typically 5347 for XMPP components).

database_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file where user mappings and channel state are stored.

tls_cert.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if use_tls=true.

tls_key.description: Absolute path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if use_tls=true.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections to the XMPP server.

starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS negotiation (only used if use_tls=true and supported by the XMPP server).

max_connections_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent IRC connections allowed per XMPP user.

max_channels_per_server.description: Maximum number of channels a single IRC connection may join.

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity after which an IRC connection is closed.

admin_jid.description: XMPP JID (bare or full) of the service administrator. Receives operational notices and errors.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for Biboumi’s runtime logs.

log_level.description: Verbosity level: NONE, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, or TRACE.

irc_servers.description: List of IRC servers to connect to. Each server block defines its own connection settings.

port.description: IRC server port (6697 for TLS, 6667 for plaintext).

password.description: Server password (if required). Leave empty if none.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS for this IRC connection.

autojoin.description: Whether to autojoin channels defined below on connection.

modes.description: Channel modes to request upon join (e.g., 'nt' for 'no-ctcp + topic lock'). Leave blank for default.
